Coding agents adapt to a project through configuration files,
instruction prompts, tool definitions, and plugins.
This chapter explains how to configure agent environments,
install project-level instructions,
author and share Agent Skills (`SKILL.md`),
connect external capabilities via the Model Context Protocol (MCP),
structure agent plugins,
and use advanced developer extensions like Magic Context, Conductor,
and the Antigravity Python SDK.
